findings.claim: In the working-hours check in checkIfIsAvailable, `end` is computed from slotStartTime instead of slotEndTime, so start and end are identical. A slot that starts inside working hours but runs past workingHour.endTime is not rejected.

The working-hours check uses workingHours.find(day matches && slot outside range), so it rejects a slot that is outside any one range for that weekday instead of requiring it to be inside some range. Days with split hours or hours split at UTC midnight lose valid slots.
`dayjs(date.start) === dayjs(date.end)` compares object references and is always false. The zero-length ('unavailable all day') date override branch therefore never runs.
In the override check, dayjs(date.start).add(utcOffset, 'minutes') and the equivalent for end are rebuilt four times instead of computing the shifted start/end once per override.
